title: Tokimeki Memorial - Densetsu no Ki no Shita de
aliases: Tokimeki Memorial: Densetsu no Ki no Shita de
description: Tokimeki Memorial is the first in the long-running series of dating sims by Konami which started life on the PC Engine. Released in 1994, it boosted the popularity of the dating sim genre in Japan immensely.
